thread.title: Apple Stock Gets Fresh Buy Rating On Services Growth Potential | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Gets Fresh Buy Rating On Services Growth Potential | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Investment bank JPMorgan initiated coverage of Apple stock with the equivalent of a buy rating on Thursday, citing the iPhone maker's large customer base and fast-growing services business.
X JPMorgan analyst Samik Chatterjee set a price target on Apple ( AAPL ) of 272 along with an overweight rating. Apple stock jumped 2.1% to 224.95 on the stock market today . It hit a record high of 229.67 on Sept. 5.
Apple stock has "considerable upside" potential from current levels, he said. Catalysts include a faster-than-expected transformation to a services business and rising average selling prices for iPhones, Chatterjee said in a report.
Apple's services revenue has risen from 8% of sales in fiscal 2012 to 13% in fiscal 2017. It is on track to hit 20% of sales by 2021, he said.

It is poised to achieve a revenue target of $48 billion by fiscal 2020, ahead of schedule.
Apple's recent acquisitions of digital magazine subscription service Texture and music discovery app Shazam point to its services focus, he said.
Apple also could get a lift from entering new markets, Chatterjee said.
"Certain end-markets in our view could be of interest, including gaming services, automotive services, and smart speakers," he said.
Continued share buybacks and dividends also will provide a tailwind for Apple stock, he said.
